entities.summary: Kelly Jones is an American former doubles world No. 1 tennis player. Jones reached the finals in doubles at the Australian and US Opens in 1992. He was the Head Men's Tennis Coach at Furman University in Greenville, South Carolina from 2011 to 2019. He was replaced by former assistant J.J. Whitlinger.
